Not the shop's own domain (it runs on Instagram only), so recorded as verified rather than authoritative. A 2026/06 first-hand review corroborates かけうどん at ¥680 and 本日の野菜天ぷら at ¥430. tokyo_chanko_beya_asakusa.price_note: Prices approximate — may change. Taken from the shop's own 公式 site (お料理 / コース料理 / お飲み物 pages), which states 価格は税込 — the figures below are tax-included. Address on the page is 台東区浅草1-2-12, matching the Asakusa record. Two house rules a traveller needs to know: the hotpots are a minimum two-person order, and an お通し cover charge of ¥700 per person is added on top of everything, courses included. NOTE for whoever merges this: the site's 前菜／おつまみ・サラダ and 主菜 blocks at the foot of the お料理 page are unedited theme filler (メニュー名メニュー名 … 1,000円 … 説明文コメント) and have been ignored.

items.note: だし巻きは白だし・醤油入りが定番。Rolled omelette is normally made with shirodashi or soy sauce.

items.en: Chilled block of tofu
items.note: 豆腐自体は大豆のみだが、鰹節と醤油が乗るのが通例。The tofu is soy only, but it normally arrives topped with bonito flakes and soy sauce — ask for it plain.

items.en: Assorted Japanese pickles
items.note: 漬物の調味液に醤油・アミノ酸が入ることが多い。Japanese pickles are commonly steeped in soy-containing liquor.

items.en: Mountain yam cut into matchsticks — crunchy and slippery at once
items.note: 通常は海苔と醤油が添えられる。Usually served with nori and soy sauce on the side.

items.en: Napa cabbage kimchi
items.note: キムチにはアミの塩辛・魚醤が入るのが通例。Kimchi normally contains salted shrimp or fish sauce, and often soy.

items.en: Dried, grilled ray fin — chewy, salty, the classic thing to drink over
items.note: 味付き乾物は醤油・みりんを含むことが多く、マヨネーズが添えられる。Seasoned dried fin often carries soy and mirin, and it comes with mayonnaise.

items.en: Fried udon noodles
items.note: うどんは小麦、ソースも小麦。Wheat noodle and wheat sauce.

items.ja: お茶漬け（鮭・明太・梅）
items.en: Rice in green tea broth — choose salmon, spicy cod roe or pickled plum
items.note: 茶漬けの素は醤油・かつお。Ochazuke stock powder contains soy and bonito.

items.en: Sashimi rice bowl, miso soup included
items.note: 丼のタレ・味噌汁とも醤油/味噌。The bowl's sauce is soy and the miso type is not stated.

items.ja: おにぎり（鮭・明太・梅）
items.en: Rice ball — salmon, spicy cod roe or pickled plum
items.note: 梅なら小麦なしの可能性が高いが、明太子は醤油漬け。The ume version is the likeliest to be wheat-free; mentaiko is soy-cured.

items.en: Grilled rice ball, one piece
items.note: 焼きおにぎりは醤油を塗って焼く。Grilled rice balls are brushed with soy sauce.

items.en: House mixed salad
items.note: ドレッシング未記載＝和風ドレッシングなら醤油。Dressing not published; Japanese-style dressings contain soy.

items.en: Seafood salad
items.note: ドレッシング未記載。Dressing not published.

items.en: Green tea ice cream
items.note: 乳製品使用。銘柄未記載のため増粘剤等不明。Dairy; brand not stated so stabilisers are unknown.

items.en: Glutinous rice-flour dumplings — the name says 'gluten' but shiratama is pure rice
items.note: 白玉粉は米粉で小麦不使用だが、きな粉/黒蜜/餡の調達先は未記載。Shiratama flour is rice, not wheat, but the accompanying syrup or bean paste is not specified — ask.

items.en: Komusubi course (a sumo rank) — chanko hotpot, two-kind sashimi, one grilled dish. Any of the four broths. Two-person minimum, cover charge extra
items.note: 鍋の味は4種から選択可。See the individual hotpot notes; ask about the broth.

items.en: Ozeki course — hotpot, three-kind sashimi, grilled dish, salad
items.note: 同上。Same caveats as the hotpots and sashimi above.

items.en: Yokozuna course — hotpot, four-kind sashimi, grilled dish, salad and a rice or noodle finish
items.note: 締めがうどん/中華麺の場合は小麦。If the finish is udon or ramen noodles it is wheat.

items.en: Oyakata (stablemaster) course — hotpot, five-kind sashimi, grilled dish, a fried dish, salad, rice or noodle finish and fruit
items.note: 揚物が含まれる＝小麦の衣・共用フライヤー。Includes a fried course, so wheat batter and a shared fryer.

items.ja: 旬の地野菜と海鮮コース
items.romaji: shun no jiyasai to kaisen course
items.en: Seasonal local vegetable and seafood dinner course
items.note: 献立の詳細はサイト未掲載（テンプレート文のまま）。The site has not filled in this course's contents — ask when booking.

items.en: Two-hour all-you-can-drink, course diners only (last order at 1h45)
items.note: ビール・ハイボールを含むためグルテンフリー不可。Includes beer and highballs, so never gluten-free.

items.ja: アサヒスーパードライ生
items.en: Asahi Super Dry draught
items.note: 麦芽＝グルテン。Malted barley.

items.en: Bottled beer
items.note: 麦芽＝グルテン。Malted barley.

items.ja: ノンアルコールビール
items.en: Alcohol-free beer
items.note: ノンアルでも麦芽由来。Alcohol-free but still barley-malt based.

items.en: Shochu highball with fresh-squeezed lemon
items.note: ベース焼酎の原料（麦か芋か）未記載。The base shochu is not identified — a barley shochu would carry gluten, so ask for an imo (sweet potato) base.

items.ja: 生グレープフルーツサワー
items.en: Shochu highball with fresh grapefruit
items.note: 同上、ベース焼酎未記載。Same — ask which shochu is the base.

items.en: Shochu with oolong tea
items.note: ベース焼酎未記載。Base shochu not identified.

items.en: Shochu with green tea
items.note: ベース焼酎未記載。Base shochu not identified.

items.en: Mitake sweet-potato shochu, by the glass
items.note: 芋焼酎だが麹に麦を使う銘柄がある。Sweet-potato shochu, but many brands use a barley koji — ask if you are strict.

items.en: Isami sweet-potato shochu, by the glass
items.note: 同上、麹の原料に注意。Same barley-koji caveat.

items.en: Iichiko barley shochu, by the glass
items.note: 麦＝大麦。Barley shochu — never gluten-free.

items.ja: ブラックニッカ（ロック・水割り・ハイボール）
items.en: Black Nikka whisky, on the rocks, with water, or as a highball
items.note: モルトウイスキー＝大麦。Malt whisky is barley.

items.ja: 竹鶴プレミアム（ロック・水割り・ハイボール）
items.en: Taketsuru Premium blended malt
items.note: モルトウイスキー＝大麦。Malt whisky is barley.

items.ja: 大徳利（京都伏見ふりそで）
items.en: Large flask of sake — Furisode from Fushimi, Kyoto
items.note: 米・米麹・水のみの清酒。Sake is rice, rice koji and water — no wheat and no animal product.

items.ja: 八海山 特別本醸造 一合
items.en: Hakkaisan special honjozo, one go (180 ml)
items.note: 本醸造は米・米麹・醸造アルコール。Honjozo is rice, koji and distilled alcohol — no wheat.

items.ja: 久保田 千寿 一合
items.en: Kubota Senju, one go (180 ml)
items.note: 米・米麹・醸造アルコール。Rice, koji and distilled alcohol.

items.ja: 濃醇梅酒（ロック・水割り・サワー）
items.en: Rich plum wine, however you want it
items.note: ベーススピリッツ未記載（ブランデー/麦焼酎の場合あり）。The base spirit is not stated and some umeshu use barley shochu or brandy.

items.ja: はんなり梅酒 北川本家（ロック・水割り・サワー）
items.en: Hannari plum wine from Kitagawa Honke of Fushimi
items.note: ベース未記載。Base spirit not stated.

items.en: Half bottle of wine, red or white
items.note: ワイン自体は小麦なし。清澄剤に卵白・ゼラチンを使う銘柄あり。Wine carries no wheat; fining agents may be egg or gelatine, and the label is not named.

items.en: Full bottle of wine, red or white
items.note: 同上。Same fining caveat.

items.en: Orange juice
items.section: ソフトドリンク Soft drinks
items.note: 果汁のみ。Juice only.

items.en: Cola
items.section: ソフトドリンク Soft drinks
items.note: 炭酸飲料、小麦不使用。Carbonated soft drink, no wheat.

items.en: Oolong tea
items.section: ソフトドリンク Soft drinks
items.note: 茶葉のみ。烏龍茶であって麦茶ではない。Oolong leaf only — note this is not mugicha, which would be barley.

items.en: Green tea
items.section: ソフトドリンク Soft drinks
items.note: 茶葉のみ。Green tea leaf only.

tokyo_nadai_fuji_soba_suidobas.price_note: Prices approximate — may change. These are the chain-wide prices published on 名代 富士そば's own site, tax included, under the notice 令和8年8月1日より一部価格を改定いたします (a price revision effective 2026-08-01). There is NO branch page for 水道橋店 any more — the old /m/shop/... URL now redirects to the chain top page — so branch-specific prices could not be checked, and the site itself warns 地域により金額に差があります (prices vary by area) and その他に店舗限定のメニューは沢山あります (many branch-only items exist). Dropped to partial for that reason. The 水道橋店 entry in the chain's shop list confirms the address 千代田区神田三崎町2-1-16 (白山通日大前) and that it closes only 03:00–04:00, i.e. effectively 24 hours.

items.en: The base bowl — hot soba (or udon, same price) in the house tsuyu, nothing on top. This is the cheapest hot meal in the neighbourhood at 4am
items.section: 温かいそば・うどん Hot soba/udon
items.note: 富士そばの生そばは小麦つなぎ、つゆは小豆島の醤油から作るかえし＋かつお出汁（公式「味へのこだわり」記載）。The shop's own page states the tsuyu is built from a Shodoshima soy-sauce kaeshi and freshly ground bonito dashi — wheat and fish.

items.en: The signature bowl — the house's own combination topping
items.section: 温かいそば・うどん Hot soba/udon
items.note: 麺・つゆとも小麦。Noodle and tsuyu both wheat.

items.en: Soba topped with wakame seaweed
items.section: 温かいそば・うどん Hot soba/udon
items.note: わかめ自体は問題ないが麺・つゆが小麦とかつお。The wakame is fine; the noodle and the bonito-and-soy broth are not.

items.ja: ほうれん草そば（うどん）
items.en: Soba topped with boiled spinach
items.section: 温かいそば・うどん Hot soba/udon
items.note: 麺・つゆとも小麦・かつお。Wheat noodle, bonito-soy tsuyu.

items.en: Soba under sweet-simmered sliced beef
items.section: 温かいそば・うどん Hot soba/udon
items.note: 肉の煮汁も醤油・味醂。The beef is simmered in soy and mirin.

items.en: Soba with a kakiage fritter dropped on top — the fritter softens into the broth; the classic order
items.section: 温かいそば・うどん Hot soba/udon
items.note: 天ぷらの衣は小麦、2014年より店内揚げ（公式記載）で共用フライヤー。Wheat batter, fried in-store since 2014 in a shared fryer per the company's own page.

items.en: Soba with a fritter of red pickled ginger — bright pink, sharp, and a Tokyo standing-soba institution
items.section: 温かいそば・うどん Hot soba/udon
items.note: 衣は小麦、共用フライヤー。Wheat batter, shared fryer.

items.en: Soba with a potato croquette floating in it — a Tokyo standing-soba oddity worth trying once
items.section: 温かいそば・うどん Hot soba/udon
items.note: コロッケのパン粉・衣は小麦。The croquette's breadcrumb coat is wheat.

items.en: Cold soba on a tray with dipping tsuyu, one ball of noodles
items.section: 冷たいそば・うどん Cold soba/udon
items.note: つけつゆも醤油・かつお。The dipping tsuyu is soy and bonito.

items.en: Double portion of cold soba, two balls of noodles — not sold at every branch
items.section: 冷たいそば・うどん Cold soba/udon
items.note: 販売していない店舗あり（公式記載）。The site says not all branches sell it; wheat and soy as above.

items.ja: 冷したぬきそば（うどん）
items.en: Cold soba with crisp tempura batter bits
items.section: 冷たいそば・うどん Cold soba/udon
items.note: 天かすは小麦の揚げ衣。Tenkasu is fried wheat batter.

items.ja: 冷しきつねそば（うどん）
items.en: Cold soba with sweet-simmered fried tofu
items.section: 冷たいそば・うどん Cold soba/udon
items.note: 油揚げは醤油・味醂で炊く。The abura-age is simmered in soy and mirin.

items.ja: 冷し特撰富士そば（うどん）
items.en: Cold version of the signature bowl — April to September only
items.section: 冷たいそば・うどん Cold soba/udon
items.note: 4〜9月限定。Seasonal, April–September; wheat and soy as above.

items.ja: 冷し肉富士そば（うどん）
items.en: Cold soba with simmered beef — April to September only
items.section: 冷たいそば・うどん Cold soba/udon
items.note: 4〜9月限定。Seasonal, April–September.

items.en: Japanese curry over rice
items.note: カレールーは小麦粉でとろみをつける。Japanese curry roux is thickened with wheat flour.

items.ja: カレーライスセット かけそば（うどん）
items.romaji: curry rice set with kake soba (udon)
items.en: Curry rice plus a bowl of soba or udon — hot, or cold mori if you prefer
items.note: 両方小麦。Both halves are wheat.

items.en: Breaded pork cutlet and egg over rice — the company makes a point that it is a real single cut of pork, cooked to order
items.note: パン粉＝小麦、特製ダレは醤油、卵とじ。Breadcrumbs are wheat, the tare is soy, and it is bound with egg.

items.ja: かつ丼セット（もりそば又はかけそば）
items.en: Katsudon plus a bowl of soba or udon
items.note: 両方小麦。Both halves wheat.

items.en: Small curry plus your pick of four noodle bowls — hot or cold, soba or udon
items.note: ルーも麺も小麦。Roux and noodle both wheat.

items.en: The morning bowl — soba or udon, tanuki or kitsune, hot or cold, with a poached onsen egg included. Sold 05:00–10:00 at every branch, one button on the ticket machine covering eight combinations
items.note: どの組み合わせも小麦麺＋醤油つゆ、温泉玉子付き。Every combination is a wheat noodle in soy-bonito tsuyu, plus an egg.

items.en: Dried-sardine ramen — a branch-limited item, not sold everywhere
items.section: おすすめ・店舗限定 Recommended / branch-limited
items.note: 店舗限定（公式記載）。中華麺は小麦。Branch-limited per the site; ramen noodles are wheat. Confirm it is sold at Suidobashi before counting on it.

items.en: Pork cutlet over rice under curry sauce — branch-limited
items.section: おすすめ・店舗限定 Recommended / branch-limited
items.note: パン粉・ルーとも小麦。Breadcrumbs and roux both wheat.
